feature: Windows client restart and new CLI terminal from client cards and connection completion
nativeCoverage: Private windowless WinExe compiled and started at a path containing spaces and a quote
Same-name sentinel at another executable path remains untouched
PID creation time, account SID and desktop session verified by actual Windows CIM
Background process without a closable window remains alive and restart is refused
Current host and ancestors are protected
Isolated profiles never fall back to real installed applications
Current-user and all-user nested Start Menu discovery
Similar shortcut names and directory junctions are skipped
limitations: Tray/background processes and unsaved prompts may require manual exit.
CLI actions open a new terminal and do not end existing sessions.
Ambiguous Store entries and shortcuts with additional arguments require manual handling.
Existing ChatGPT desktop enhancement connections need reconnecting after restart.
